title: Neural Ordinary Differential Equations
authors: Ricky T. Q. Chen, Yulia Rubanova, Jesse Bettencourt, David Duvenaud
abstract: We introduce a new family of deep neural network models. Instead of specifying a discrete sequence of hidden layers, we parameterize the derivative of the hidden state using a neural network. The output is computed using a black-box differential equation solver.
sample_notes:
# Field Derivation: Continuous Depth & Adjoint Gradients

Problem:
Discrete layers in ResNets: $h_{t+1} = h_t + f(h_t, \theta_t)$.
In the infinitesimal limit $\Delta t \to 0$:
$\frac{d h(t)}{d t} = f(h(t), t, \theta)$

Trajectory Output:
$h(t_1) = h(t_0) + \int_{t_0}^{t_1} f(h(t), t, \theta) dt$

Adjoint State Method (Memory O(1)):
$a(t) = \frac{\partial L}{\partial h(t)}$
$\frac{d a(t)}{d t} = -a(t)^T \frac{\partial f(h(t), t, \theta)}{\partial h}$

Solve backwards in time alongside augmented dynamics.
